items.info: Center Pedestal. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Main Panel. Lowers the landing gear.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Pedestal. Verify thrust levers are at the idle detent before applying power.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Pedestal. Ensure both engine fuel cutoff levers are in the off position to prevent premature fuel flow.
items.label: Fuel Levers

items.info: Pedestal. The flap lever position must match the indicated flap setting before powering hydraulics to avoid uncommanded movement.
items.label: Flap Lever

items.info: Pedestal. Ignition selector set to NORM. The A or B positions are only used during engine start.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Ensure windshield wipers are off to prevent scratching dry glass.
items.label: Wipers

items.info: Pedestal. Switch to ON (1 or 2) to verify the test pattern on the ND, then return to OFF.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Overhead Panel. Switch all three batteries (BAT 1, 2, 3) to ON. White lines through the switches indicate they are active.
items.label: Batteries

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnect once the APU is supplying electrical power. Skip this step if no GPU is connected.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set the NAV & LOGO selector to position 1 to make the aircraft visible to others.
items.label: Nav Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Hold the test button to verify the APU fire warning systems are operational.
items.label: APU Fire Test

items.info: Overhead Panel. Perform a fire test for each engine to ensure warning lights and bells function correctly.
items.label: Engine Fire Tests

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn all fuel pumps on. The crossfeed valve remains in the auto position.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Powers the APU controller and initiates the intake flap opening sequence.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Press to initiate the APU start sequence. The right ECAM will automatically display the APU page.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Move all three selectors to NAV to begin alignment. The FROM/TO must be entered in the MCDU for the alignment to complete.
items.label: ADIRS Selectors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on the Oxygen LO PR Supply located on the rear overhead panel.
items.label: Crew Oxygen

items.info: Overhead Panel. Powers the galley systems for cabin service preparation.
items.label: Galley

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on Captain, Standby, and First Officer probe heating to prevent icing on the sensors.
items.label: Probe Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Activates window heating to prevent fogging and improve bird strike resistance.
items.label: Window Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Arm the system so exit lights illuminate automatically during a loss of power.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set to AUTO so strobes activate automatically when airborne.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set the No Smoking selector to AUTO; the seatbelt sign will follow this selector's logic.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Overhead Panel. Scan for any white indicator lights. In a normal dark cockpit configuration, none should remain illuminated.
items.label: Overhead Panel

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on after APU AVAIL illuminates to provide bleed air for engine start. Verify the X FEED selector is in the auto position.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnect once the APU is supplying electrical power. Skip this step if no GPU is connected.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Pedestal. Adjust cockpit and panel lighting knobs on the side panels and pedestal to suit ambient conditions.
items.label: Internal Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on the Flight Recorder ground control switch to ensure CVR and FDR record while on the ground.
items.label: GND CTL

items.info: Pedestal. Enter flight parameters including FROM/TO, INIT, F-PLN, and TO/APPR data. Use the left LSK to insert and confirm each leg.
items.label: MCDU Preflight

items.info: Glareshield. Engage both ATS levers on the eyebrow trim panel. This requires the IRS alignment to be completed.
items.label: Autothrust

items.info: Glareshield. Engage both Pitch Trim levers. This also requires complete IRS alignment.
items.label: Pitch Trim

items.info: Glareshield. Engage both Yaw Damper levers to provide stability augmentation.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: EFB. Enter mass and balance data to run the takeoff calculation. Standard configuration uses Flaps 15/0.
items.label: Takeoff Performance

items.info: Glareshield. Adjust EFIS brightness and select the desired ND mode, such as ROSE NAV or ARC.
items.label: EFIS Mode

items.info: Glareshield. Turn on the Flight Director and set the brightness selector to the middle position.
items.label: Flight Director

items.info: Glareshield. Select NAV mode to display flight plan information on the navigation display.
items.label: VOR/NAV/ILS

items.info: Glareshield. Set the DH selector to -5, then OFF if no decision height is required for departure.
items.label: Minimums

items.info: Glareshield. Set the expected runway heading on the FCU.
items.label: Heading Bug

items.info: Glareshield. Dial in the initial cleared altitude or cruise flight level.
items.label: Altitude Selector

items.info: Glareshield. Set the SPD/MACH selector to the calculated V2 speed.
items.label: Speed Selector

items.info: Glareshield. Preselect PROFILE and NAV modes on the FCU for the initial climb.
items.label: AP Modes

items.info: Main Panel. Adjust both altimeters to the local QNH pressure setting.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Main Panel. Synchronize or verify the clock time for accurate flight logging.
items.label: Clock

items.info: Overhead Panel. Push to test the ground proximity warning system and verify GPWS shows ON after a few seconds.
items.label: EGPWS

items.info: Main Panel. Set the anti-skid system to NORM to ensure maximum braking efficiency during rejected takeoff or landing.
items.label: Anti-Skid

items.info: Main Panel. Dial in the destination landing elevation on the pressurization panel under the MCP.
items.label: LAND ALT

items.info: Main Panel. Push the gear warning test button and listen for the audible warning tone.
items.label: Gear Warning Test

items.info: Main Panel. Select FLX TO, TOGA, or AUTO on the Thrust Rating Panel. If using FLX TO, input the assumed temperature from the EFB.
items.label: TRP

items.info: Pedestal. Verify the speed brake lever is fully retracted and disarmed.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Advance Throttle 1 to verify the warning tone and Master Warning, then return to idle. Repeat with Throttle 2.
items.label: Takeoff Warning Test

items.info: Pedestal. Set the assigned squawk code and keep the mode in STBY until lining up on the runway.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. Verify the rudder trim is centered at zero.
items.label: Rudder Trim

items.info: Pedestal. Switch to ON (1 or 2) to verify the test pattern on the ND, then return to OFF.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Side Console. Press the test button to verify oxygen flow and communication capabilities.
items.label: Oxygen Mask

items.info: EFB. Remove the GPU, chocks, and any other ground services before pushback.
items.label: Ground Connections

items.info: Main Panel. Verify on the ECAM that all aircraft doors are closed and secured.
items.label: Doors

items.info: Pedestal. Secure the cockpit door prior to departure.
items.label: Cockpit Door

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the total fuel on board matches the flight plan requirements.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: Side Console. Ensure both flight deck windows are fully closed and locked.
items.label: Windows

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on the beacon light to warn ground personnel that engines are about to start or the aircraft is moving.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Pedestal. Ensure the parking brake is set before ground equipment is removed.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Switch to XPDR mode prior to pushback to ensure ATC visibility.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: EFB. Initiate pushback using the EFB controls.
items.label: Pushback

items.info: Main Panel. Start the elapsed timer to monitor the engine start sequence duration.
items.label: Clock

items.info: Pedestal. Move the ignition selector to A or B. CONT RELIGHT is only used for turbulence, icing, or heavy precipitation.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Press START 2. The switch will display OPEN as the start valve actuates.
items.label: Engine 2 Start

items.info: Pedestal. Lift Fuel Lever 2 when N2 reaches 20% to introduce fuel and initiate combustion.
items.label: Fuel Lever 2

items.info: Overhead Panel. Press START 1. The switch will display OPEN.
items.label: Engine 1 Start

items.info: Pedestal. Lift Fuel Lever 1 when N2 reaches 20%.
items.label: Fuel Lever 1

items.info: Main Panel. Watch N1, N2, EGT, and fuel flow stabilize. The crossfeed system is fully automatic on the A310.
items.label: Engine Parameters

items.info: Pedestal. Return the ignition selector to NORM after both engines have stabilized.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off the APU bleed air since the engines now provide pneumatic pressure.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shut down the APU to save fuel now that engine generators are online.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn ON if TAT is below 10°C in visible moisture.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Pedestal. Pull the speed brake lever up to arm the ground spoilers for a potential rejected takeoff.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Set the flaps for takeoff. Standard configuration is Flaps 15/15.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Adjust the pitch trim wheel to the calculated takeoff CG value from the EFB.
items.label: Pitch Trim

items.info: Pedestal. Confirm the rudder trim remains centered.
items.label: Rudder Trim

items.info: Yoke. Perform full and free control sweeps on all axes while monitoring the ECAM display.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Main Panel. Review the ECAM memo to ensure no residual warnings or abnormal system states exist.
items.label: ECAM Status

items.info: Pedestal. Release the parking brake to commence taxi.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Switch nose lights to TAXI. Use runway turn-off lights if necessary.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Apply brief pedal pressure to verify normal braking during the initial roll. Keep taxi speeds under 30 knots.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Glareshield. Confirm V2, cleared altitude, and runway heading are correctly dialed in.
items.label: FCU Bugs

items.info: Glareshield. Verify V2, altitude, and heading are set, and that PROFILE and NAV modes are preselected.
items.label: FCU Panel

items.info: Glareshield. Confirm both flight directors are active.
items.label: Flight Director

items.info: Main Panel. Look at the Flight Mode Annunciator above the PFD to ensure armed modes correspond to FCU selections.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Main Panel. Select MAX autobrake to ensure immediate deceleration in case of a rejected takeoff.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Pedestal. Confirm the speed brake lever is pulled up and armed.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Double-check that slats and flaps are correctly positioned for takeoff.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Press the T.O. Config button to verify no configuration warnings trigger.
items.label: T.O Config

items.info: Pedestal. Press the cabin call button to notify flight attendants of impending takeoff.
items.label: Cabin

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn strobes ON as you enter the active runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on landing lights upon runway entry.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Move the nose light switch to the TO (takeoff) position.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn wing lights on to enhance aircraft visibility.
items.label: Wing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on if brake temperatures are high from a long taxi.
items.label: Brake Fans

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn OFF for maximum thrust takeoffs if required by company SOP, otherwise leave ON.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Pedestal. Switch TCAS to TA/RA for traffic alerting during flight.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. Activate the weather radar for departure weather scanning.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Main Panel. Activate the terrain display if departing in mountainous areas.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Pedestal. Apply toe brakes firmly while engines spool up.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Pedestal. Stabilize engines at 40% N1, release brakes, and advance levers or press TO/GA on the glareshield.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the PFD shows THR, SRS, and HDG in green indicating active takeoff modes.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Main Panel. Raise the gear lever once a positive rate of climb is established.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Glareshield. Engage autopilot 1 or 2 above 400 feet AGL.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Glareshield. Verify or engage autothrust shortly after the autopilot is active.
items.label: Autothrust

items.info: Main Panel. At thrust reduction altitude, verify P.THR, P.CLB, and NAV are active. The FCU SPD/MACH and V/S windows should be dashed.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Main Panel. Ensure the Thrust Rating Panel automatically switched to AUTO or CL after the thrust reduction phase.
items.label: TRP

items.info: Pedestal. Retract flaps to 1 above F-speed, and to 0 above S-speed.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Push the speed brake lever down to disarm ground spoilers.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Main Panel. Move the gear lever to the middle neutral position once retraction is complete to depressurize the hydraulics.
items.label: Gear Lever

items.info: Overhead Panel. Restore pack flow if they were turned off for takeoff.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Ensure APU bleed is off as engines are now supplying cabin air.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Ensure the APU is shut down.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off taxi lights as they are no longer needed in flight.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off brake fans once brakes have cooled.
items.label: Brake Fans

items.info: Main Panel. Disarm the MAX autobrake setting used for takeoff.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Main Panel. Pull the altimeter knobs to set standard pressure (29.92 inHg / 1013 hPa) when passing the transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off landing lights when climbing past 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign off if smooth above 10,000 ft.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Main Panel. Deactivate terrain display to declutter the navigation screen above 10,000 feet.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Main Panel. Verify the Thrust Rating Panel is in AUTO or CR (cruise) mode.
items.label: TRP

items.info: Overhead Panel. Monitor cabin altitude and differential pressure on the ECAM to ensure proper pressurization.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Main Panel. Periodically check fuel burn against the flight plan.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: Glareshield. Ensure the aircraft is tracking the active route and sequencing waypoints correctly.
items.label: Flight Plan

items.info: Main Panel. Monitor the distance to the calculated descent point. A standard 3-degree descent requires roughly 3 NM per 1,000 feet of altitude loss.
items.label: Top of Descent

items.info: Pedestal. Verify the destination, STAR, and approach in the F-PLN page. Enter baro minimums and verify landing speeds on the TO/APPR page.
items.label: MCDU Approach

items.info: Pedestal. Tune the localizer frequency and approach course on the NAV radios.
items.label: ILS Frequency

items.info: Main Panel. Ensure destination field elevation is set on the pressurization panel.
items.label: LAND ALT

items.info: Glareshield. Dial the decision height or baro minimums for the approach. Set 200 feet if no specific minimum is published.
items.label: Minimums

items.info: Main Panel. Select LO or MED autobrake depending on runway length and conditions.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Glareshield. Dial down to the cleared altitude or initial approach fix altitude and pull the knob to arm the descent.
items.label: Altitude Selector

items.info: Main Panel. Ensure sufficient fuel remains for the approach, go-around, and diversion if necessary.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: Glareshield. Verify automatic descent in PROFILE mode, or manually select LVL CH if required by ATC.
items.label: Descent

items.info: Pedestal. Move to CONT RELIGHT if descending through icing, turbulence, or heavy precipitation.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Activate engine and wing anti-ice if TAT is below 10°C in visible moisture.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on landing lights when descending below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on runway turn-off lights for increased visibility below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Main Panel. Activate the terrain display if descending into mountainous terrain.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Main Panel. Push the altimeter knobs to revert to local QNH when passing the transition level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Pedestal. Cross-check that the correct ILS frequency is active and identified.
items.label: ILS Frequency

items.info: Glareshield. Switch the display mode to ILS to view localizer and glideslope deviations.
items.label: VOR/NAV/ILS

items.info: Glareshield. Select LVL CH about 3,000 feet above the runway to capture the localizer first, then intercept the glideslope from below.
items.label: Altitude Mode

items.info: Glareshield. Press the LAND button on the FCU to arm LOC and GS capture prior to the final approach fix.
items.label: Approach Mode

items.info: Glareshield. Engage the second autopilot to enable LAND 2 or LAND 3 dual-channel autoland capabilities.
items.label: 2nd Autopilot

items.info: Main Panel. Confirm GS and LOC are armed in blue, and switch to active green upon capture.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Pedestal. Select Flaps 15/0 when airspeed drops to the green dot marker.
items.label: Flap Lever

items.info: Pedestal. Intermediate flap extension to 15/15 — increases lift and begins slowing the aircraft for approach.
items.label: Flaps 2

items.info: Main Panel. Lower the landing gear and verify three green lights prior to 1,000 feet AGL.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Pedestal. Pull the speed brake lever up to arm the spoilers for automatic deployment on touchdown.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Overhead Panel. Set the nose light switch to the TO position for landing.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Further extension to 15/20 — more drag and lift for a stabilized final approach.
items.label: Flaps 3

items.info: Pedestal. Select Flaps 30/40 to establish the final landing configuration.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Main Panel. Ensure the anti-skid system remains in NORM for landing rollout.
items.label: Anti-Skid

items.info: Main Panel. Verify that the LAND mode is latched on the PFD by 200 feet AGL.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Pedestal. Retard thrust levers to idle when the auto-callout sounds at roughly 30 feet.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Pedestal. Pull the reverser levers to apply reverse thrust, reducing to idle reverse as you decelerate through 80 knots.
items.label: Reverse

items.info: Yoke. Disconnect the autopilot after rollout or prior to minimums for a manual landing.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Pedestal. Confirm the autobrake disengages when applying manual brake pressure or dropping below 30 knots.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Strobes will automatically shut off when exiting the runway if set to AUTO, or turn them OFF manually.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off landing lights once clear of the active runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Switch nose lights back to the TAXI position.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off wing lights if they are no longer needed.
items.label: Wing Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Retract all flaps and slats for the taxi to the gate.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Push the speed brake lever down to retract and disarm the ground spoilers.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on brake fans if heavy braking caused high brake temperatures.
items.label: Brake Fans

items.info: Pedestal. Return the ignition selector to NORM.
items.label: ENG Mode

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off wing anti-ice, keeping engine anti-ice on only if ground icing conditions persist.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Start the APU to provide electrical power and bleed air at the gate.
items.label: APU

items.info: Pedestal. Turn off the weather radar to protect ground crew.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Main Panel. Turn off the terrain display to declutter screens.
items.label: Terrain on ND

items.info: Pedestal. Switch the transponder to STBY to stop broadcasting airborne signals.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. Set the parking brake upon reaching the final parking position.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU bleed on before engines shut down so pneumatic supply is maintained at the gate.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off all remaining anti-ice systems.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Pedestal. Switch both engine fuel levers to OFF to shut down the engines.
items.label: Fuel Levers

items.info: Main Panel. Stop the elapsed timer to record final block time.
items.label: Clock

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off taxi lights as the aircraft is parked.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off the beacon light once engines have fully spooled down to signal ground crew it is safe to approach.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign OFF.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify the cabin differential pressure reads zero before opening doors.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off all fuel pumps. Leave L INNER 2 on if the APU is going to remain running.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off window heating.
items.label: Window Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off probe heating to prevent the pitot tubes from overheating on the ground.
items.label: Probe Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off brake fans once temperatures are within normal ranges.
items.label: Brake Fans

items.info: Overhead Panel. Secure the crew oxygen supply valve.
items.label: Crew Oxygen

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off the remaining exterior lights like NAV and LOGO.
items.label: External Lights

items.info: Glareshield. Turn off the ATS levers.
items.label: Autothrust

items.info: Glareshield. Turn off the Pitch Trim levers.
items.label: Pitch Trim

items.info: Glareshield. Turn off the Yaw Damper levers.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disarm the exit lights to prevent battery drain while powered down.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connect and establish external power from the GPU before shutting down the APU.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off the APU bleed.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shut down the APU.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off all three IRS selectors to power down the navigation systems.
items.label: ADIRS Selectors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Switch all three batteries off. This is the final step to fully de-power the aircraft.
items.label: Batteries

description: The shorter, longer-range sibling of the A300 that introduced Airbus’s two-pilot glass cockpit.
